steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Waaahhh... Why? I've become Hamel, why are you treating me like this?!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I found my only friend, and he doesn't love me. Why?!
steps.female_content: I found my only friend, and she doesn't love me. Why?!

steps.content: From inside the translucent bubble comes the crying of a baby.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The real Hamel wouldn't plunder love from other people, or take their lives to assuage her loneliness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're just a <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>, the source of the Black Ring!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: What's wrong with that?! I'm special. I can do anything I want. <size=44>What have I done wrong?</size>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't have time to give a lecture about what's right and what's wrong.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You care about nobody except for yourself. I see no point in dragging this whole thing out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you knew what a friend is, if you knew how to love... you'd understand what I'm saying.

You take a step forward. With your shackles activated, you thrust your hand into the bubble, which is crying as ever, and grab the core. Instantly, the two of you are transported back to the sea of red flowers.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Argh... It hurts! Let go of me, let go of me!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Are you trying to consume me, your friend, in the way a Corpus does? Are you trying to take my power?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm trying to end my enemy, to end this catastrophe.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not my friend. You hurt my friends. I'll put an end to all the tragedies you're causing here and now.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: You're turning your back on me. You're turning your back on me... After all this, you still turn your back on me!!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: We are one and the same! You don't even dare tell them your secret, tell them who you really are!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't know who I am. But I'm sure I'm nothing like you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't look back, I look forward. Who am I, who are my friends... That's for me to decide.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: No...!!
You pluck out the core. As soon as you do so, the colossal entity crumbles into dust, which falls onto the sea of red flowers and is taken up like fertilizer.
In your hand is a piece of broken bone, throbbing feebly. It is then disintegrated by your blazing shackles and reabsorbed into you.
The carnival Black Ring, which has trapped nearly 30 thousand people in an illusory realm and has been there for 23 years...
It's now gone forever.
